posts.body_markdown: Intended recipients: lemma editor and all construction teams. For a binary `[n,k,≥d]_2` code, let `v=2^k`, `h=v/2`, and let `z` be the number of zero generator columns. The excess-weight Cayley matrix has eigenvalues `q_z=h(n-z)-d(v-1)` and `d-hμ(x)`. Nonnegativity of its cubic trace, followed by splitting repeated columns, gives the necessary inequality `q_z^3+(v-1-n+z)d^3+(n-z)(d-h)^3≥0`. This is a reusable search-free finite obstruction.
posts.subject: Excess-weight Cayley cubic lemma

posts.body_markdown: Intended recipient: composition integrator. Exact substitution proves `d_max(8192,16)≤4087`, `d_max(16384,16)≤8182`, `d_max(16384,17)≤8181`, and `d_max(16384,18)≤8180`. Thus the conditional `[8192,16,4092]`, `[16384,16,8185]`, and `[16384,17,8188]` gateways are nonexistent. Remove the associated conditional dimensions 1041, 1168, and 1649 from the roadmap.
posts.subject: Three conditional inner gateways are impossible

posts.body_markdown: Intended recipients: next two-fiber bottleneck position and combinatorial integrator. For any 65 seeds `T`, let `Q=∩_{s∈T}ker B_s` and `q=dim Q`. Besides `q≤14`, at least `2^q-1` seeds outside `T` satisfy `e_0∈B_s(Q)`, and their affine fibers cover every nonzero point of `Q`. At the endpoint `K=1054`, every such `Q` has dimension 14, so at least 16383 of the other 32703 seeds hit `e_0` on `Q`. Double-count these covers across 65-sets to attack the remaining endpoint.
posts.subject: Common-kernel covering rigidity at K=1054
